texts.Chiron|Aries 28|H1: Someone may be disappointed in you, and it can touch an old sore spot in how you see yourself. Their hopes may say more about them than about your worth. Keeping your word and saying plainly what you can do may help the hurt ease. Chasing approval, or taking on their bitterness, could keep it raw.
texts.Chiron|Aries 28|H10: In your career, an old sense of not living up to expectations may press. With effort, you can bring what you learned the hard way into new ways of working, stand by your word and make peace with it. Pining for how things used to be, or performing for applause, keeps the ache alive.
texts.Chiron|Aries 28|H10|Sun Cancer 27: At work, a familiar dread of disappointing people in charge may be building again, perhaps through a small crisis. Meet it calmly, keep your commitments and say what's true; working through it may finally ease the sting. Hiding in routine, or chasing approval from above, leaves it sore.
texts.Chiron|Aries 28|H11: An old fear of failing your friends may come back. Trial and error is how you learn here; tell people honestly what you can and can't deliver, and their support may let the sore spot close. Ducking your part, or telling everyone what they want to hear, only deepens it.
texts.Chiron|Aries 28|H11|Sun Gemini 27: In a group, an old ache about not fitting in may be resurfacing. Commit to people who let you grow, say honestly what you can offer and keep your word; reaching out first may let it ease. Refusing to join because you were once left out, or playing to the room, prolongs it.
texts.Chiron|Aries 28|H1|Sun Aries 27: An old sore spot about letting others down may slowly stir again, perhaps after a setback. Committing only to what you can really do, and deciding for yourself what counts as success, could help it finally ease. Self-pity, or bending over backwards to please everyone, could keep it from closing.
texts.Chiron|Aries 28|H3: An old sore point about whether your words count may stir in everyday exchanges. Say what you plan to do, then actually do it, carefully and with your whole attention; that follow-through can let it ease. Promising lightly, sloppy effort, or letting others carry the practical stuff keeps it tender.
texts.Chiron|Aries 28|H3|Sun Aquarius 27: In conversations, an old fear of saying the wrong thing may be coming back. Speak with care and truth, notice the meaning beneath the words, and question family rules about what can't be said; taking that step may finally ease it. Repeating stock lines, or pleasing every listener, keeps it sore.
texts.Chiron|Aries 28|H4: In family life, someone's disappointment may press on an old tender spot. Notice the small signals, speak the truth gently and promise only what you can deliver; working at it may let the sore place settle. Forcing your way, or absorbing everyone's resentment, keeps it hurting.
texts.Chiron|Aries 28|H4|Sun Capricorn 27: At home, an old ache about disappointing your family may be building. Give yourself quiet time away to sort out what you value, then keep your word to them, even when it's uncomfortable, and it may ease. Putting on a show of being the good one, or bending to every mood, keeps the tension going.
texts.Chiron|Aries 28|H5: An old insecurity around play, romance or your talents may ease without much struggle. Make something both useful and beautiful, say honestly what you can give, and stand by it. Clinging to the safe old way out of timidity, or doing it only to be applauded, lets the chance pass.
texts.Chiron|Aries 28|H5|Sun Sagittarius 27: A lingering worry about being good enough may start to loosen, especially as you give a creative idea real form. Promise only what you can keep and let others help shape it. Polishing it until it's stiff, playing to the crowd or never starting keeps the old ache alive.
texts.Chiron|Aries 28|H7: A partner's disappointment, or yours, may touch an old tender spot. Let go of needing to be special to them, speak truthfully and trust that you're held by more than this one bond; then it may ease. Expecting them to make it right, or wishful thinking, keeps you both stuck.
texts.Chiron|Aries 28|H7|Sun Libra 27: With a partner, an old hurt about disappointing each other may be coming back. Step back far enough to see both sides, then deal with the real situation and keep your promises; that may help the sore spot close. Hovering above the problem, or blaming them for your letdown, keeps it raw.
texts.Chiron|Aries 28|H9: An old doubt about the big questions in your life may ease almost on its own as you pick the single opportunity that fits you best and speak for it openly. Others may be disappointed by your choice; that's theirs to carry. Dithering for the thrill of options, or chasing applause, leaves the doubt in place.
texts.Chiron|Aries 28|H9|Sun Leo 27: An old disappointment about what you think of life may slowly hurt less, and each day you see more clearly what you stand for. Say what you think and stand by it, even if not everyone likes it. Just because the old hurt fades almost by itself, don't stop there, kid yourself that all is well or simply go along with the popular view.
texts.Jupiter|Leo 26|H1: Life may feel hopeful again, and you can trust that your steady effort is part of why. Stay grounded while you aim higher; a fresh start can grow from it. Don't get overconfident, though: if you wait for luck or dodge the dull daily work, the fresh start never gets going.
texts.Jupiter|Leo 26|H10: A career goal may look promising, but getting there probably means adjusting to changing conditions again and again. Keep making the effort and use whatever resources turn up; you can feel at home in new roles. Shrugging and accepting less, or banking on a lucky break, would stall your rise.
texts.Jupiter|Leo 26|H11: In a group project or among friends, a hope you share may really start to pay off. Bring warmth, willpower and clear thinking to it, and offer to lead a part yourself. Drifting between grand plans and easy fun, or expecting luck to do the work, lets the chance pass.
texts.Jupiter|Leo 26|H3: A class, a chat or a short trip could prove that steady learning really does pay off. Cut the clutter from your days and you may see something familiar with fresh, delighted eyes. It needs your initiative: half-hearted effort, cramming in too much or waiting for inspiration leaves it flat.
texts.Jupiter|Leo 26|H4: Plans for your home or family may look bright, yet getting there asks for patient, honest effort. Say only what you mean and keep showing up; that steadiness is what pays off. Big promises, smooth talk around a conflict, or hoping it sorts itself out leave things as they were.
texts.Jupiter|Leo 26|H5: Fun, romance and creative work may feel full of promise now, as if steady effort is finally paying off. Pick the few joys that really matter to you and do them well. Easy luck tempts you to coast or to grab at every offer, and that soon leaves you frazzled.
texts.Jupiter|Leo 26|H7: In a partnership, you may feel hopeful one moment and sure the other person is holding things up the next. Look at how your arrangement really works and keep putting in steady effort; it tends to pay off for both. Worrying about every detail, or waiting for them to fix it, wears you down.
texts.Jupiter|Leo 26|H9: Study, travel or a cause you believe in may flow easily now and show what steady commitment can achieve. Put your energy into the shared goal and keep a modest tone. Lofty speeches with nothing behind them, or lazily waiting for the reward, would miss what's possible.
texts.Jupiter|Leo 27|H1: You may feel ready to begin again, as if a confusing stretch is behind you and your confidence is back. Grab a chance boldly, with a plan you can really follow. The same lift can tip into overrating yourself, and then the confusion comes back.
texts.Jupiter|Leo 27|H10: At work or in public, a fresh beginning in a bigger role may be within reach, but getting there takes more nerve than you'd like. Say clearly what you want and back it with a plan. Settling for routine, or bragging about goals you haven't worked out, keeps you stuck.
texts.Jupiter|Leo 27|H10|Sun Scorpio 28: In your career or public role, a fresh urge to aim higher may be building while outside demands try to set your course. Get clear on what you really want and focus on that one goal. Letting worry or daydreams run your head, or trusting to luck, costs you progress.
texts.Jupiter|Leo 27|H11: In a group or among friends, a project close to your heart could get a second wind, and you may see the bigger picture. Say yes when you're invited in, and handle a practical part yourself. Floating above the daily details, or promising too much, keeps it on paper.
texts.Jupiter|Leo 27|H11|Sun Libra 28: In a circle of friends or a shared project, a feeling of belonging may be growing, along with the trust to start something new together. Join in fully, and check the facts first. Half-hearted effort, or hoping it works out without your part, leaves it a nice idea.
texts.Jupiter|Leo 27|H1|Sun Leo 28: A new beginning may be gathering pace in you, with more confidence and more options than you can use. Choose the one that serves your long-term aims and give it your full attention. Wanting it all at once, or keeping every door open too long, scatters your effort.
texts.Jupiter|Leo 27|H3: A class, a short trip or a new contact nearby could make learning feel new again, if you sign up and show up. Choose what you'd gladly give your time to. Hanging back like an outsider, or grabbing every idea at once, means nothing new sticks.
texts.Jupiter|Leo 27|H3|Sun Gemini 28: With neighbours, siblings or in a class, the courage to try again after a flop may slowly be returning. Reach out to people and treat the mistake as practice, not a verdict. Dodging your share of it, or pretending it never happened, puts off the next attempt.
texts.Jupiter|Leo 27|H4: At home or in the family, starting over on a bigger scale may tempt you, but wishing alone won't make it happen. Plan it calmly, step by step, and stay involved without steering everyone. Meddling in every detail, or shrugging that nothing matters, leaves home exactly as it was.
texts.Jupiter|Leo 27|H4|Sun Taurus 28: In your family or living situation, a wish to begin again may be taking hold, while old doubts keep pushing back. Don't settle for less out of false modesty; work out what's realistic and start there. Grand promises, or giving up after one disappointment, keep the old setup in place.
texts.Jupiter|Leo 27|H5: Starting fresh in love, play or a creative project may come easily now, even after something fell flat. Let the last try show you what success really means to you. Big hopes with no plan, or sulking over the flop, leave the idea stuck in your head.
texts.Jupiter|Leo 27|H5|Sun Aries 28: In dating, a hobby or a creative project, the joy may be coming back after a muddled spell, and with it the nerve to show your work. Promise only what you can deliver. Someone else's letdown is theirs; playing to the crowd, or overpromising, turns fun into a chore.
texts.Jupiter|Leo 27|H7: With someone close, privately or at work, one of you may want to start over while the other clings to how it's always been. Ask gently what your shared habits still mean to each of you. Insisting on the old way, or promising the moon, strains the bond.
texts.Jupiter|Leo 27|H7|Sun Aquarius 28: In a close bond, at home or in business, a new plan may be taking shape while one of you dreams big and the other counts the cost. Think ahead together and share the hands-on work. Leaving the chores to them, or getting carried away, wears the bond thin.
texts.Jupiter|Leo 27|H9: Learning, travel or passing on what you know may feel light and new again. Give your idea of how things should be a visible form, such as a text, a project or a talk. Left as a pleasant daydream, or turned into lecturing, it won't outlast the mood.
texts.Jupiter|Leo 27|H9|Sun Sagittarius 28: Through study, travel or teaching, a fresh outlook may be opening up with ease, and you could see how to bring it into daily life. Build something that works well and is a pleasure to use. Sticking to the familiar out of inertia, or preaching about it, leaves the insight unused.
texts.Mars|Leo 26|H1: Your confidence and your will to start fresh may merge, bright and persistent. Keep working at it and expect joy to follow. Waiting for things to fall into your lap, or ditching boring tasks, dims the glow.
texts.Mars|Leo 26|H10: Your ambitions may get a real push, yet the payoff comes from steady, determined work rather than a gamble. Stay grounded and keep at it. Getting bored and bolting, or forcing results through confrontation, would cost you the reward.
texts.Mars|Leo 26|H11: Persistent work with friends or a community may finally show results, and an opening to push further could appear. Make that move with confidence. Losing interest once it turns routine, or counting on luck, lets it fizzle.
texts.Mars|Leo 26|H3: Practising a skill or keeping a conversation going could show results, and the chance to go further may appear. Use it with patient energy. Chasing a quick thrill out of boredom, or leaving it to luck, cuts it short.
texts.Mars|Leo 26|H4: Your drive to make home life better may meet resistance, but steady work does bring results here. Keep doing the dull, necessary parts. Losing patience and storming off, or escaping into something more exciting, leaves it half-done.
texts.Mars|Leo 26|H5: Your drive to create, or to put real energy into romance, may flow freely. Keep at it steadily and trust it to pay off. Lazily waiting for a lucky break, or dropping it once it gets dull, wastes the spark.
texts.Mars|Leo 26|H7: Pushing someone you work closely with for results, you may expect them to keep the promise. Put in your own patient effort; shared work bears fruit when conditions are right. Picking fights from boredom, or blaming them, wears it thin.
texts.Mars|Leo 26|H9: Your faith that persistence pays may be easy to act on in learning, travel or a bigger life plan. Push for the long-term goal and let joy fuel it. Coasting on hope, or fleeing anything dull, lets the promise slip.
texts.Mars|Leo 27|H1: You may feel like a new person after a confusing phase, eager to start something and show up differently. The same push that gets you going can make you rash or prickly, so give each new start a concrete step.
texts.Mars|Leo 27|H10: At work, you may finally see clearly again and feel keen to try a new approach, but those in charge could resist. Back the idea with a realistic plan and persist; losing your temper, or quitting, would set you back.
texts.Mars|Leo 27|H11: In your circle of friends or a group you belong to, a stalled plan may pick up speed again. Propose a realistic next step; if you wait for others to move, or push too hard, the plan may stall again.
texts.Mars|Leo 27|H3: After some confusion with a sibling or neighbour, you could get a chance to clear the air and start fresh. Make the first move and say plainly where you stand; just waiting, or one sharp word, may leave things unresolved.
texts.Mars|Leo 27|H4: At home or with family, you may want a fresh start after a muddled stretch, while others prefer things as they are. Turn the change into a workable plan; snapping at them, or giving up, keeps the tension going.
texts.Mars|Leo 27|H5: After a flat spell, your enthusiasm for romance, fun or making something may return with fresh energy. Starting over comes easily now; give the new idea a simple plan and a first step before impatience pushes it aside.
texts.Mars|Leo 27|H7: You may be ready to move on from a misunderstanding with a partner, friend or colleague, while they hold on to it, or the reverse. Tell them what you'd like to try next; blaming each other restarts the argument.
texts.Mars|Leo 27|H9: Your appetite for travel, study or a bold plan may come back after a spell of doubt. Acting on it feels easy: book the trip or sign up for that course, without rushing off unprepared or leaving it a daydream.
texts.Mars|Leo 28|H1: You may have the energy to go after a lot right now, and part of you enjoys keeping every option open. Decide which goal is truly yours and commit to it; wanting everything at once tends to end in frustration.
texts.Mars|Leo 28|H10: Several projects or career moves may compete for your drive, and none comes without a snag. Commit to the one that serves your long-term goals and tackle its weak spot head-on; juggling them all can leave you overstretched and irritable.
texts.Mars|Leo 28|H11: Friends or contacts may bring you more offers and plans than you can possibly join. Choose the one that fits your longer-term hopes and say yes clearly; drifting between them all wears you out and makes you snappy.
texts.Mars|Leo 28|H3: Messages, invitations and small offers may pile up, and among them could be one worth chasing, perhaps a workshop or a useful contact. Single it out and follow up yourself; answering everything half-heartedly just keeps you busy, irritable and stuck.
texts.Mars|Leo 28|H4: Several things at home may want your energy at once, from family plans to repairs or a possible move. Pick the most pressing one and face it squarely; trying to tackle everything, or looking away, leaves you tense and short-tempered.
texts.Mars|Leo 28|H5: Plenty of ideas, flirts or fun plans may be on offer, and you have the drive to go after them. Picking your favourite comes naturally; chasing every one at once leaves nothing finished and frays your temper.
texts.Mars|Leo 28|H7: In a close relationship, personal or professional, one of you may want to seize a chance now while the other keeps weighing options. Agree on one step together and name the problem; pulling in opposite directions ends in a quarrel.
texts.Mars|Leo 28|H9: Many paths may tempt you, from a course or a trip to a question about life you want to explore. Choosing one and diving in comes easily; keeping them all open is thrilling until you grow impatient and nothing happens.
texts.Mars|Leo 29|H1: A strong urge to act on your instincts may take hold, with no wish to tone yourself down. That boldness is attractive yet can run over people; notice who is standing next to you before you charge ahead.
texts.Mars|Leo 29|H10: An idea for your work or public image may feel urgent, and you may want to make it happen now. Others may push back, so use tact; charging ahead over colleagues or superiors could turn your enthusiasm into public embarrassment.
texts.Mars|Leo 29|H10|Sun Scorpio 30: At work or in public, an urge to break out of routine with a bold idea may be building. Let off steam where it's welcome, for instance at a team event; clashing clumsily with the rules, or bottling it up, could cost you respect.
texts.Mars|Leo 29|H11: A group project with friends may suddenly grab you, and you could be the one to get it going. Pitch it with enthusiasm, then leave room for others' wishes; steamrolling them may cost you their goodwill.
texts.Mars|Leo 29|H11|Sun Libra 30: With friends or in a group, the wish to get one of your ideas moving may build. Bring it forward with what you know and stay curious about how others see things; lecturing, or brushing past their concerns, would leave you arguing alone.
texts.Mars|Leo 29|H1|Sun Leo 30: A wish to be exactly who you are, with nothing hidden, may be growing stronger. Being open can win trust, though it can also hurt people, so speak freely but choose whom you confide in; suspecting everyone, or barging in tactlessly, pushes people away.
texts.Mars|Leo 29|H3: An idea you can't wait to share may come up while chatting, writing or learning something new. Act on the urge before it slips away and share it with a little tact; blurting it out could put people off.
texts.Mars|Leo 29|H3|Sun Gemini 30: A chance to share an idea you're excited about may come up soon, with people nearby or in a course. Take it and show your skill without false modesty; speaking without thinking, or turning on the charm to get your way, makes people wary.
texts.Mars|Leo 29|H4: You may suddenly know exactly what you want to change at home, and want it now. Family members could push back; say what you want but listen too, since rushing ahead over their feelings can end in awkward apologies.
texts.Mars|Leo 29|H4|Sun Taurus 30: You may increasingly want to do things at home your own way, which can clash with how your family has always done them. Show what you can do while respecting your roots; pushing too fast, or withdrawing in hurt pride, leaves everyone more stubborn.
texts.Mars|Leo 29|H5: When a creative idea or a spark of attraction hits, you can act on it at once and wholeheartedly. Going for it feels effortless; still notice how it lands with others, or a careless move could leave you embarrassed.
texts.Mars|Leo 29|H5|Sun Aries 30: Little by little, the urge to throw yourself into a romance, a hobby or something creative may grow. It's easy to say yes to it and handle your everyday duties reliably; just don't settle for routine, or rush in without noticing how others feel.
texts.Mars|Leo 29|H7: You may want something from someone close, in love or in business, and feel impatient for it, while they may need longer. Say honestly what you're after and hear their side; pushing too hard may make them pull back.
texts.Mars|Leo 29|H7|Sun Aquarius 30: With someone close, your push to get what you want may keep rising, and so may your trust that they mean well. Do your own share and treat them kindly; expecting them to sort everything out, or pressing past their feelings, strains the bond.
texts.Mars|Leo 29|H9: A sudden pull towards a journey, a new subject or a cause you believe in may be hard to resist. Following it feels natural; just don't push your enthusiasm on people who don't share it, or things may get awkward.
texts.Mars|Leo 29|H9|Sun Sagittarius 30: You may feel more and more drawn to speak up for an issue you care about, perhaps on behalf of others. That role suits you now; carry it with integrity rather than for applause, and don't run over those who disagree.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 10|H1: Your thoughts may circle back to belonging: old friends, shared memories, a sense of 'us'. That can feel warm. Just notice if you start thinking only what the group thinks; enjoy the company and keep your own mind.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 10|H10: At work, team spirit may grow, along with quiet pressure to conform, and an old discussion could come back. Be a good colleague and still think for yourself. Simply nodding along, or going it alone, both miss the point.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 10|H11: Among friends, a reunion or an old group chat can bring real warmth, if you reach out first. Losing your own course in everyone's plans would cost more than it gives. Enjoy belonging and keep your direction.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 10|H3: Conversations with friends, siblings or neighbours may pick up old threads and feel warm and connecting. Send the first message. Repeating group opinion without thinking it over would flatten it; share the warmth, keep your own view.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 10|H4: At home, family talk may turn back to togetherness and old shared times. Belong and still speak for yourself. Dissolving into the family view, or pulling away to avoid it, leaves something important unsaid.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 10|H5: Social fun, shared meals or group play can come easily, maybe with people from your past. Drifting along with the crowd would dull it, so bring your own spark and enjoy the company.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 10|H7: A partner or ally may want more togetherness, or you may, and old talks about it could resurface. Merging completely and insisting on independence pull in opposite directions. Closeness lasts when both keep their own minds.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 10|H9: Learning in a group or travelling with others can feel easy and bonding, and you may revisit an idea you once shared. Taking on the group's opinions untested would be too easy; stay curious on your own terms.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 11|H1: You may think again about how you can help, and feel ready to step in. That calm confidence can carry others. Getting swept up in panic, or avoiding every risk, would get in the way; stay steady and reach out.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 11|H10: At work, a crisis may call for calm words, maybe about an issue you thought was settled. Lead with steady confidence. Spreading alarm, or ducking responsibility, would make it harder for everyone, you included.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 11|H11: In groups, you can be the one who keeps a level head when emotions run high, if you choose to speak. Being swept along by the crowd's mood would cost you that role. Stay calm and connected.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 11|H3: Talks or messages can bring help to someone in need, or to you, perhaps from an old contact. Make the first call. Passing on alarming rumours would only add noise; be the calm voice in the conversation.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 11|H4: At home, someone may need support or reassurance, and you can step in. Calm confidence and practical care work best. Panicking, or overprotecting until nobody can breathe, would turn worry into tension.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 11|H5: Caring for a child, partner or friend can feel natural and easy right now. Playing it too safe could take the fun out, so enjoy a small adventure together and trust each other.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 11|H7: A partner may seem to need rescuing, or you may feel you do. Helper and helpless are two roles that can flip back and forth. Support works when both trust things can turn out well.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 11|H9: Ideas about standing up for others or for a bigger cause can inspire you with ease. Getting caught in collective excitement or alarm would cloud your view; keep your own judgement and your confidence.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 12|H1: Your mind may turn back to diplomacy: whom you're loyal to and how you show it. Review where that loyalty truly belongs. Keeping loyalties out of habit, or hiding behind empty politeness, would leave you saying words you don't mean.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 12|H10: At work, office politics may heat up again. Handle power with tact and re-examine whom you really serve. Empty gestures to please the boss, or open defiance, would cost you trust you may need later.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 12|H10|Sun Aquarius 13: At work, reading the mood before you speak may get harder as tensions build. Look at what's actually happening and plan your next move; rehearsing every scenario in your head, or telling those in charge what they want to hear, won't prepare you.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 12|H10|Sun Aquarius 14: A tricky talk at work may be heading your way, one you can't simply avoid. Face it with courtesy and a clear position; empty politeness that just ticks the box, or angling for praise, would leave the problem exactly where it is.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 12|H10|Sun Aquarius 15: In your job or public role, setting your own terms may meet growing pushback, and saying them out loud takes some nerve. State them calmly and clearly, then let yourself enjoy the result; envying a colleague's success would sour your own.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 12|H10|Sun Aquarius 16: With deadlines or tight budgets at work, keeping everyone on side may get tougher as the pressure builds. Organise the details and speak plainly about priorities; flattering the right people to get ahead would leave you little to show for it.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 12|H10|Sun Aquarius 17: At work or in public, you may soon need to protect your position without turning cold. Stay decent and say clearly what you won't accept; treating every newcomer with suspicion, or smiling while you seethe, would cost you allies.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 12|H11: In groups, alliances and loyalties may shift, and careful diplomacy can keep doors open once you make the move. Hollow networking would only collect names; invest in connections with real value.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 12|H11|Sun Capricorn 13: In a group or club, a chance to steer a discussion toward a goal you genuinely care about may be coming up. Speak up tactfully, after checking your own motives; overselling your role or your ideas would cost you the group's trust.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 12|H11|Sun Capricorn 14: Among friends or in a network, you may get a growing chance to start something that lasts, such as a regular meet-up or a shared project. Propose it and welcome other views; acting as if it all hinges on you would put people off.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 12|H11|Sun Capricorn 15: With friends, a chance to offer real support may be taking shape, through kind words or a practical plan for someone who needs it. Reach out; feeling sorry for yourself, or just echoing someone's complaints, would leave everyone feeling worse.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 12|H11|Sun Capricorn 16: In a running club, team or group, friendly competition may spur you on more and more, and a fair word keeps rivalry good-natured. Give it your all; following the loudest voice out of fear would mean your own ideas never get heard.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 12|H11|Sun Capricorn 17: Among friends, a chance to drop the polished version of yourself may be coming your way. Say what you really think, kindly and quirks included; hiding it all behind careful politeness would make those friendships feel more formal than they need to be.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 12|H1|Sun Scorpio 13: Your words may carry more and more weight in how others see you, for better or worse. Tact and real curiosity let you connect ideas others miss; hiding behind smooth phrases, or shelving plans because you feel out of your depth, keeps them unspoken.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 12|H1|Sun Scorpio 14: You may increasingly become the one who keeps people talking to each other. Listen and share freely, yet keep a clear opinion of your own; prying into others' private business, or agreeing with everyone, would leave you with none.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 12|H1|Sun Scorpio 15: How you present yourself may be shifting toward something lighter: admitting what you don't know and asking openly. That candour can disarm people, but getting tangled in polite routines and duties could make you forget what you actually enjoy.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 12|H1|Sun Scorpio 16: A friendly word or a smile from you may start to soften even a prickly relationship. Let people see what you really think too; staying guarded, or relying on charm alone, would keep things pleasant on the surface and distant underneath.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 12|H1|Sun Scorpio 17: You may increasingly want to speak for yourself rather than repeat what others expect. Say where you stand, tactfully but in your own words; borrowed opinions, or quietly dodging a hard conversation, would make you sound less sure than you are.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 12|H3: In talks, tact can keep a difficult relationship open, and you may see where your loyalties really lie. Make the first approach. Hollow courtesies would ring false, so be polite and still honest.
texts.Mercury|Scorpio 12|H3|Sun Virgo 13: When neighbours, siblings or a local group get caught up in a muddled discussion, a chance to sort it out calmly may soon open up. Take the first step and tactfully propose a clear way forward; hesitating lets the confusion decide for you.

Use intuition and careful thought to work out a way of thinking you'd be proud of, with real care and passion. Studying out of mere duty, settling for a convenient view, or chasing a showy one leaves you with empty words.
texts.Saturn|Aries 9|H9|Sun Leo 8: An idea about life that no longer fits may come up for a second look, and letting it fall apart could make room for something better. Trust your inner sense and check it with reason. Since dropping the old view comes fairly easily, it's tempting to just rant about it instead of working out what you think now.
texts.Uranus|Gemini 4|H1: A wish to live and present yourself more freely may resurface, perhaps through simpler, older ways or a ritual of your own. Give it a second look before you change everything. Swapping styles on a whim, or breaking with the past for its own sake, leaves you restless.
texts.Uranus|Gemini 4|H10: At work, a wish for more freedom may return, like your own project or more say in how you work, and old rules push back. Ask which habits and rules still make sense, and welcome different views. Storming out, or writing others off, leaves you on your own.
texts.Uranus|Gemini 4|H10|Sun Virgo 3: In your job or public life, a push for more freedom may be gathering again, such as working more independently, while fixed structures resist. A small routine that grounds you can keep you steady and confident. Showing off, doubting everything or quitting on impulse could stop the change halfway.
texts.Uranus|Gemini 4|H11: Among friends or in a group, you may return to something that's truly yours, such as a shared tradition you give your own twist. Speak up about what you've managed, even the small steps. Needing applause, or rebelling just to stand out, would make those friendships wobble.
texts.Uranus|Gemini 4|H11|Sun Leo 3: With friends or in a team, the wish to do things your way may be growing again, even if it sets you apart. Decide clearly which group customs you want to keep. Going along for comfort, or standing out just for show, chips away at your self-worth.
texts.Uranus|Gemini 4|H1|Sun Gemini 3: A wish to reinvent how you live may be building again, this time with a need for clear order, maybe a daily routine that's yours. Polish what you already have rather than starting from zero. Blaming your background, or overturning everything on impulse, leaves you scattered.
texts.Uranus|Gemini 4|H3: Talking with someone dear may bring back an idea you'd shelved: a small custom of your own, just for the two of you. Suggest it, and enjoy it without explaining yourself. Doing it to look different, or out of duty, takes the joy out of it.
texts.Uranus|Gemini 4|H3|Sun Aries 3: In talks with siblings, neighbours or colleagues, you may slowly see again how much your background shapes your thinking, and how you shape others too. Bring up your own take. Echoing what everyone says, or pretending your roots don't count, keeps your real view unspoken.
texts.Uranus|Gemini 4|H4: At home, an old urge for space of your own may flare up again while everyone's needs crowd together. Look at which household habits still feel right, and negotiate a change that suits more than you. Slamming the door, or pushing just your own plan, makes it even more crowded.
texts.Uranus|Gemini 4|H4|Sun Pisces 3: In your home life, the urge to change something may be stirring again while old habits dig in. Notice which family customs still mean something and which you keep only from fear of change. Freezing everything, or tearing it all down at once, unsettles everyone.
texts.Uranus|Gemini 4|H5: A creative hobby you let go may draw you back, and your own style in it can come almost naturally. Make it a small regular ritual, just for you, away from everyday duties. Showing off with it, or dropping it the moment it bores you, keeps it from lasting.
texts.Uranus|Gemini 4|H5|Sun Aquarius 3: In romance, hobbies or creative work, an old wish to drop habits that never suited you may be returning, and it can feel lighter than expected. Stay loyal to what you truly chose. Breaking every rule on principle, or clinging to old ties out of fear, leaves no room to play.
texts.Uranus|Gemini 4|H7: In a partnership or close friendship, the question of how much freedom each of you needs may come back, maybe over shared habits you've outgrown. Talk it through openly and accept support when it's offered. Cutting ties in a rush, or shutting yourself away, only leaves you lonelier.
texts.Uranus|Gemini 4|H7|Sun Sagittarius 3: In a love or business relationship, a tug-of-war over freedom and your shared habits may be heating up again, with every push meeting a push back. Think about where each reply might lead before you choose. Playing the victim, or insisting you're right, could end in a rash break.
texts.Uranus|Gemini 4|H9: In a class, on a trip or around a table with like-minded people, a question about old traditions you once set aside may return, and fresh answers come surprisingly easily. Add your own view. Drifting along with the group, or chasing every exotic idea, teaches you little.
texts.Uranus|Gemini 4|H9|Sun Libra 3: Travel, study or a different outlook on life may be drawing you back, and trying fresh ideas can feel easy. Experiment on purpose and choose what has meaning for you, not what's trendy. Sliding into the same old opinions, or hopping between beliefs, gets you nowhere new.
texts.Uranus|Gemini 5|H1: A strong urge may rise to stop living the way most people expect and show a truer side of yourself. Some may smile at it; let them, and talk with those who see things very differently until you know where you stand. Picking quarrels to prove a point wastes the spark.
texts.Uranus|Gemini 5|H10: A picture of the work you'd really like to do may be getting hard to ignore. Say it out loud, even if colleagues find it odd, then plan and build; it takes work. Stay silent and you serve someone else's vision; skip the hard facts and it stays a daydream.
texts.Uranus|Gemini 5|H11: Unconventional new friends may show you your own path in a much bigger frame. Take the step toward them, even if it feels risky; you can grow surer of yourself. Being the star of the group matters less than you think, and the safe old crowd won't stretch you.
texts.Uranus|Gemini 5|H3: A new way of learning or a talk with an unusual thinker may shake up how you see things. Trust your first instinct and act on it: send the message, book the course. Ordinary chats count too, so don't dismiss them as boring or turn them into quarrels.
texts.Uranus|Gemini 5|H4: Home rules may suddenly feel too tight, maybe around money or who gets included. Change them openly and fairly, and expect something good to come of it, though it takes work. Leave no one out, even the quieter ones, and skip the fights with relatives who see it differently.
texts.Uranus|Gemini 5|H5: A fresh creative idea or a freer way of loving may come easily. It works best when you build on what others started and give it your own twist, dreamy and practical at once. Rejecting anything new out of habit dulls it, and pretending you invented it all is just as false.
texts.Uranus|Gemini 5|H7: Someone close may challenge your views head-on, or want more freedom than you expected. Even in a tense moment, stay calm inside and look for what's true in it; that's where the relationship can renew itself. Clowning around to smooth it over wastes the moment, as does arguing in circles.
texts.Uranus|Gemini 5|H9: Something you always took for granted about life may loosen easily, perhaps through someone who lives their view instead of preaching it. Looking again lets you go past what most people think. Be careful with the new insight, though: arguing with everyone who disagrees, or using it to talk down to others, means nobody really hears it.
texts.Venus|Libra 23|H1: You may want to show more of yourself and say what you like and value. It may be worth saying it, even if it sounds bold and not everyone agrees. Bragging to impress, or going quiet when others disapprove, could both work against you.
texts.Venus|Libra 23|H10: Your working life may offer a second look at what you love and how openly you show it. Let people know what you can do. Bragging hurts your standing, and so does smoothing things over to stay liked.
texts.Venus|Libra 23|H11: In a friendship group or network, you may finally be the one who names what everyone half senses. Do it with warmth and a little swagger. Showing off grates; muting yourself to stay popular is just as costly.
texts.Venus|Libra 23|H3: A message, a post or a chat with a sibling may give you a chance to say what you love and believe, a little boldly. It stays open; take it. Boasting turns people off, and so does politely saying nothing.
texts.Venus|Libra 23|H4: At home or with family, what you value may want to be said out loud, and the urge lingers for days. It takes courage. Keeping quiet to stay liked, or bragging to win the argument, leaves the real point unheard.
texts.Venus|Libra 23|H5: Showing what you love, a crush, a song, a project, may flow out of you easily and linger. Let your enthusiasm be a little loud. Bragging for attention, or going quiet because someone might frown, takes the sparkle out.
texts.Venus|Libra 23|H7: With someone close, privately or at work, something you value may stay on your mind until you say it. Saying it warmly and a little boldly might ease that, even if you worry how the other person will take it. Swallowing your view out of politeness, or showing off to impress, might both get in the way.
texts.Venus|Libra 23|H9: Speaking up for your ideas about life and the dreams you love may come with unusual ease, and the urge lingers. Share them with a teacher, a fellow traveller or a class. Preachy boasting, or muting yourself to dodge disapproval, keeps your ideas from reaching anyone.
texts.Venus|Libra 24|H1: You may feel, clearer than ever, how unlike anyone else you are, and that can thrill and unsettle you at once. Show it warmly. Hiding behind a pleasing image, or wallowing in self-pity, dims it.
texts.Venus|Libra 24|H10: Your work may demand that you stand by your own unusual approach, and that isn't easy. Hold to it. Tailoring yourself to please the boss, or blaming a tough market, holds you back.
texts.Venus|Libra 24|H11: A friend or a group may open a chance to show your most distinctive side. Take the step. Going along with tired group talk to blend in, or pitying yourself, keeps that side hidden.
texts.Venus|Libra 24|H3: A conversation may open a chance to show how differently you see things. Take it and say it kindly. Echoing worn opinions to fit in, or complaining that nobody gets you, means your view never gets heard.
texts.Venus|Libra 24|H4: Home may push you to stand by what makes you different, even against old family habits. It takes effort, but it lasts. Keeping the peace by fitting in, or feeling sorry for yourself, only postpones it.
texts.Venus|Libra 24|H5: A hobby or a crush may show you a side of yourself that's one of a kind, and it flows easily. Enjoy it fully. Coasting, or grumbling that fun never comes your way, lets it pass.
texts.Venus|Libra 24|H7: A partner may hold up a mirror to what sets you apart, something you'd half forgotten. Own it, and the bond can feel fresh. Pleasing them at your own expense, or pitying yourself, keeps the old pattern.
texts.Venus|Libra 24|H9: A course, a trip or a book may easily show you a way of seeing that's entirely your own. Enjoy it and use it. Lazy comfort, or clinging to stale opinions, lets it fade.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H1: You may start seeing past your own surface and other people's to what really counts. It can feel gentle and strange. Valuing people for looks alone, or sliding into old mistakes, misses it.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H10: A colleague's quiet contribution may be easy to miss, and seeing past titles and polish takes effort. Name what they bring. Being impressed by status, or rerunning an old error, costs respect.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H10|Sun Capricorn 26: At work or in public, your wish to follow your own rhythm may run into fixed expectations. Make room for spontaneity, stay reliable, and value what colleagues do. Slipping out of duties again, or keeping everyone at a distance, leaves you lonely.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H10|Sun Capricorn 27: In your career, what you care about and what gets rewarded may be drifting apart. Stick to your own course with patience, and respect the people who helped along the way. Faking dedication, or the same old career mistake, leads nowhere.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H10|Sun Capricorn 28: At work, the mood in the team may be hinting at what people need from you. Leading with a light touch takes practice: link your goals to theirs and value each contribution. A heavy hand, or doing everything yourself out of habit, backfires.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H10|Sun Capricorn 29: In your job or public life, praise or criticism may be coming your way more often. Check it against the facts, keep what rings true, and trust your judgement. Believing every flattering word, or reading too much into small signs, throws you off course.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H10|Sun Capricorn 30: Your standing at work or in public may be rising, and with it the pull to network for advantage. Build trust with a few people and recognise their strengths. Using friends to climb, or mistaking a title for success, leaves you admired but alone.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H11: A friend may show a depth you'd overlooked, and you could be the one to say so. Reach out. Judging people by their image, or repeating an old slight, keeps the circle shallow.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H11|Sun Sagittarius 26: A group you care about, like a club or a circle of friends, may be looking for someone to rally everyone. Step forward warmly and give credit to each person's part. Grand gestures for applause, or ignoring the quieter helpers, lose you their trust.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H11|Sun Sagittarius 27: Among friends or in a group, a chance may be growing to turn a shared dream into something real. Take the lead gently, and let the others' ideas shape it. Pushing only your own vision, or rehashing an old daydream, leaves it on paper.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H11|Sun Sagittarius 28: In a group of friends, a practical job may call more and more for a lovelier touch, like setting up a shared space. Suggest it yourself and enjoy everyone's contribution. Doing it the old way, or making it a chore, kills the joy.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H11|Sun Sagittarius 29: Friends or a club may soon count on you to lend a hand. Do it your own way, give your best and see what makes each member valuable. Helping half-heartedly, copying everyone else or missing others' small efforts earns you little warmth.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H11|Sun Sagittarius 30: People in your circle may start turning to you to represent them. Take the role if it fits, stay warm and fair, and give everyone their due. Enjoying the spotlight too much, or overlooking the shy ones, can cost you their goodwill.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H1|Sun Libra 26: Your easy charm may be growing, winning people over or tipping into pleasing everyone. Choose when to be gentle and when to hold firm, and value the people who back you. Giving in to quick treats again and again leaves you frustrated.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H1|Sun Libra 27: Wanting to be liked may be building into a real talent for tact. Step back, picture how things look from the other side, then handle what's actually in front of you. Floating above it all, or the same old people-pleasing, gets nothing done.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H1|Sun Libra 28: You may feel more at ease among people and less driven to stand out. Look for the best in people and back your hopes with action. Expecting things to fall into place, or shrugging off kindness, leaves you isolated.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H1|Sun Libra 29: Wanting your gifts to be appreciated may grow stronger, and that's fair. Show what you do well and credit the people who taught you. Letting your ego run the show, or pouring time into trivia, gets in your own way.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H1|Sun Libra 30: How you come across may slowly shift from clever to warm and wise. Stay humble and look for what others know that you don't. Showing off, or dismissing other people's ideas, keeps everyone at arm's length.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H3: A sibling, neighbour or classmate may give you a chance to see past their usual act. Notice what they quietly add, and thank them. Gossiping about trivia, or falling into old misreadings, misses it.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H3|Sun Leo 26: A neighbour, a sibling or someone from your yoga class may turn warmer as the days go on. Make the first move and keep at it; steady kindness tends to pay off. Skipping the dull bits, or overlooking what they offer, keeps you strangers.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H3|Sun Leo 27: After a muddled stretch with a sibling, neighbour or old school friend, a fresh start may be coming closer. Reach out first, kindly, and notice what they've quietly done for you. Hoping it fixes itself, or slipping back into old bickering, keeps things awkward.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H3|Sun Leo 28: Invitations from neighbours, siblings or a language class may be piling up. Look past the shiny ones, pick what genuinely means something to you and say yes properly. Hovering between all of them, or getting caught up in trivia, leaves you empty-handed.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H3|Sun Leo 29: An idea for a visit, a shared hobby or a trip with a sibling or neighbour may grow more tempting. Act on it while you're excited, but keep an eye on what they want. Barging ahead, or brushing past their ideas, leads to embarrassment.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H3|Sun Leo 30: With neighbours, siblings or people you see every day, a chance to trust more may be opening up. Share something personal with someone who has earned it, and appreciate their discretion. Suspecting everyone, or oversharing as you used to, costs you that closeness.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H4: An old family pattern may resurface, and seeing what each person truly gives takes real effort. Value it out loud. Judging by the surface, or skipping the talk, repeats the same mistake.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H4|Sun Cancer 26: At home, keeping up appearances may start to clash with your need for real rest. Notice what each person in the family quietly does, and claim your own downtime. Overspending your energy to impress, or sinking into lazy old habits, leaves home tense.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H4|Sun Cancer 27: Tension in the family may be gathering, and smoothing it over gets harder. Stay calm, say how you feel, and look for what everyone is trying to give. Keeping the peace at any price, or enjoying the drama, repeats an old family pattern.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H4|Sun Cancer 28: At home, an old family custom, like how holidays go, and a newer way of living may begin to rub. Keep what still warms you and welcome what others bring. Clinging to the past, or rerunning an old quarrel, makes family time strained.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H4|Sun Cancer 29: A home or family decision may weigh more heavily on you: your gut says one thing, your head another. Give both a fair hearing, and notice what each relative actually adds. Waiting for the perfect answer, or repeating an old mistake, settles nothing.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H4|Sun Cancer 30: Family traditions, like a shared meal or yearly visit, may increasingly feel at odds with what you want now. Honour what still brings everyone together and change the rest step by step. Refusing any change, or overlooking what others contribute, makes home feel cold.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H5: An old flame, a child or a creative partner may reveal more depth than you'd noticed, without any effort. Enjoy what they bring. Being dazzled by surface charm, or overlooking their small gestures, repeats an old mistake.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H5|Sun Gemini 26: In love, play or a creative project, dropping the frills and enjoying what's simply lovely may grow easy. Look for what's unique in the other person or in your own work. Going through the motions, or repeating last time's mistake, leaves the fun lukewarm.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H5|Sun Gemini 27: Saying yes to a date, a hobby or time with kids may feel easier and easier. Give your time gladly and look past first impressions. Holding back because you once felt left out, or frittering it on trivia, keeps you on the sidelines.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H5|Sun Gemini 28: After a flop in love or creative work, laughing and trying again may get easier with time. The people who stay close are the real gain; notice what they give. Fearing another flop, or making the same one twice, keeps the fun from starting.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H5|Sun Gemini 29: After a heavy stretch, delight in flirting, play or making something may be coming back. Notice what's special about the people you admire, then add a touch of your own. Copying them forever, or getting lost in silly details, keeps your style hidden.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H5|Sun Gemini 30: Your charm in love, play or creative work may flow more freely each day. Show openly what you love and praise other people's gifts. Charm on autopilot, false modesty or slipping back into showing off puts people off.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H7: An old argument with a partner may come back, and this time you could see past the surface to what they quietly bring. Tell them, warmly. Judging by appearances, or replaying the same mistake, keeps you apart.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H7|Sun Aries 26: With someone close, you may feel torn between pleasing them and taking on far too much. As this builds, notice what they really bring and pick the few promises that matter. Saying yes to everything repeats an old mistake.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H7|Sun Aries 27: After a letdown with someone close, you may go back and forth between blaming them and blaming yourself. Slowly, a fairer picture can form: what they did give, and what you won't compromise on. Wallowing, or repeating the same mistake, keeps you stuck.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H7|Sun Aries 28: Someone close may expect more warmth or agreement from you than you can give. Over the coming days, offer only what you truly mean and give them credit for what they do. Playing to their mood, or overlooking their small kindnesses, leaves you both disappointed.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H7|Sun Aries 29: With someone close, honest appreciation may start to replace polite flattery. Tell them what you genuinely value in them, and look at your own part too. Cynical remarks, or empty compliments out of old habit, make your kind words count for less.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H7|Sun Aries 30: Over everyday things, like who plans and who follows through, you and someone close may pull different ways. Bit by bit, start valuing the small, reliable things they do. Coasting in comfort, or replaying an old argument, lets the closeness fade.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H9: A teacher, a stranger abroad or an old tradition may reveal more depth than its surface suggests, and it comes easily. Value it. Getting lost in trivia, or falling for appearances again, means you miss it again.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H9|Sun Aquarius 26: Figuring out how a new place, language or subject works may get easier by the day. Enjoy the people you meet for what makes them different. Fretting over tiny details, or coasting on what you already know, takes the joy out of discovering.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H9|Sun Aquarius 27: Travel, study or a question of faith may gradually make it easy to see what customs, like festivals, mean to you. Keep the ones that move you and adapt the rest. Following rules out of habit, or brushing off others' ways, keeps you rigid.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H9|Sun Aquarius 28: Planning a trip or a course of study may go more smoothly once you sort the practical side, like bookings and money. Give it your full attention and thank whoever helps. Leaving the groundwork to others, or half-hearted effort, leaves you scrambling later.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H9|Sun Aquarius 29: A journey, a teacher or a new subject may gently rekindle your love of learning. Stay curious about how others see the world and let a fixed opinion go. Sinking into comfortable certainties, or dabbling in trivia, keeps you standing still.
texts.Venus|Libra 25|H9|Sun Aquarius 30: Travelling, studying or meeting people from other backgrounds may easily show you how kind strangers can be. See what each person adds, and be someone others can count on. Expecting to be looked after, or drifting along, lets the goodwill fade.

textsDe.Chiron|Aries 28|H1: Jemand könnte von dir enttäuscht sein, und das kann einen alten wunden Punkt in deinem Selbstbild berühren. Die Hoffnungen anderer sagen oft mehr über sie als über deinen Wert. Hältst du dein Wort und sagst klar, was du leisten kannst, kann der Schmerz nachlassen. Wer Zustimmung hinterherläuft oder die Verbitterung anderer übernimmt, kann die Wunde offen halten.
textsDe.Chiron|Aries 28|H10: Ein altes Gefühl, den Erwartungen im Beruf nicht gerecht zu werden, könnte dir zusetzen. Mit etwas Beharrlichkeit kannst du das, was du aus Rückschlägen gelernt hast, in neue Arbeitsweisen einfließen lassen, zu deinem Wort stehen und mit diesem Gefühl Frieden schließen. Trauerst du alten Zeiten nach oder arbeitest nur für Anerkennung, hält das den Schmerz wach.
textsDe.Chiron|Aries 28|H10|Sun Cancer 27: Im Beruf könnte die vertraute Angst, Vorgesetzte zu enttäuschen, wieder wachsen, vielleicht durch eine kleine Krise. Bleib ruhig, halte deine Zusagen ein und sag die Wahrheit; stehst du das durch, könnte die Angst endlich kleiner werden. Versteckst du dich hinter der Routine oder buhlst um die Anerkennung deiner Vorgesetzten, bleibt die Angst.
textsDe.Chiron|Aries 28|H11: Eine alte Angst, deinen Freundeskreis im Stich zu lassen, könnte zurückkehren. Dabei lernst du durch Ausprobieren. Sagst du den anderen ehrlich, was du leisten kannst und was nicht, schließt sich mit ihrer Unterstützung vielleicht die Wunde. Drückst du dich davor, deinen Teil beizutragen, oder sagst allen, was sie hören wollen, wird es nur schlimmer.
textsDe.Chiron|Aries 28|H11|Sun Gemini 27: In einer Gruppe meldet sich vielleicht wieder der alte Schmerz, nicht dazuzugehören. Schließ dich Menschen an, die dich weiterbringen, sag ehrlich, was du einbringen kannst, und halte dein Wort; gehst du zuerst auf andere zu, lässt er vielleicht nach. Weigerst du dich mitzumachen, weil du einmal ausgeschlossen wurdest, oder willst nur allen gefallen, hält der Schmerz länger an.
textsDe.Chiron|Aries 28|H1|Sun Aries 27: Die alte Sorge, jemanden im Stich zu lassen, könnte sich wieder melden, etwa nach einem Rückschlag. Sagst du nur zu, was du wirklich leisten kannst, und legst selbst fest, was als Erfolg zählt, kann diese Sorge zur Ruhe kommen. Selbstmitleid oder der Wunsch, es allen recht zu machen, könnte sie wachhalten.
textsDe.Chiron|Aries 28|H3: Wenn du dich mit Menschen aus deinem Alltag austauschst, könnte die alte, schmerzliche Frage, ob deine Worte zählen, wieder aufkommen. Sag, was du vorhast, und tu es dann auch sorgfältig und mit voller Aufmerksamkeit; hältst du so Wort, kann der Schmerz nachlassen. Versprichst du leichtfertig etwas, arbeitest schlampig oder überlässt anderen das Praktische, bleibt die Stelle empfindlich.
textsDe.Chiron|Aries 28|H3|Sun Aquarius 27: In Gesprächen mit Geschwistern, Bekannten oder in der Nachbarschaft könnte eine alte Angst, das Falsche zu sagen, zurückkehren. Du könntest deine Worte sorgfältig wählen, ehrlich sein, darauf achten, was zwischen den Zeilen steht, und hinterfragen, worüber in deiner Familie nicht gesprochen werden darf, etwa über Geld oder Krankheit. Das kann die Angst endlich kleiner machen. Wiederholst du Floskeln oder willst es allen recht machen, bleibt die Angst.
textsDe.Chiron|Aries 28|H4: Wenn jemand in der Familie enttäuscht ist, könnte dich das an einer alten, empfindlichen Stelle treffen: dem Gefühl, es der Familie nie ganz recht machen zu können. Es kann helfen, auf die kleinen Zeichen zu achten, behutsam die Wahrheit zu sagen und nur zu versprechen, was sich auch halten lässt; bleibst du dabei, tut es mit der Zeit vielleicht weniger weh. Willst du mit dem Kopf durch die Wand oder lädst dir den Groll aller anderen auf, tut es weiter weh.
textsDe.Chiron|Aries 28|H4|Sun Capricorn 27: Zu Hause könnte der alte Schmerz darüber, deine Familie zu enttäuschen, stärker werden. Nimm dir Zeit für dich und kläre in Ruhe, was dir wichtig ist. Halte dann der Familie gegenüber dein Wort, auch wenn es unbequem ist; so kann der Schmerz nachlassen. Gibst du dich als das brave Familienmitglied oder beugst dich jeder Laune, bleibt die Spannung.
textsDe.Chiron|Aries 28|H5: Die alte Sorge, beim Flirten, beim Spielen oder mit deinen Begabungen nicht gut genug zu sein, könnte sich ohne großen Kampf legen. Schaff etwas, das zugleich nützlich und schön ist, sag ehrlich, was du geben kannst, und steh dazu. Hältst du aus Schüchternheit am Altbewährten fest oder machst etwas nur, um gelobt zu werden, verstreicht die Gelegenheit.
textsDe.Chiron|Aries 28|H5|Sun Sagittarius 27: Eine hartnäckige Sorge, nicht gut genug zu sein, könnte sich allmählich lösen, vor allem wenn du einer kreativen Idee eine feste Form gibst, sie etwa aufschreibst, zeichnest oder baust. Versprich nur, was du halten kannst, und lass andere mitgestalten. Feilst du daran, bis alle Leichtigkeit verloren ist, willst nur dem Publikum gefallen oder fängst gar nicht erst an, bleibt der alte Schmerz.
textsDe.Chiron|Aries 28|H7: Wenn ein Mensch, der dir nahesteht, enttäuscht ist oder du selbst es bist, könnte dich das an einer alten empfindlichen Stelle treffen: der Angst, nicht zu genügen, sobald jemand von dir enttäuscht ist. Lass den Wunsch los, für diesen Menschen etwas Besonderes zu sein, sei ehrlich und vertrau darauf, dass du auch anderswo Halt findest, etwa im Freundeskreis, in der Familie oder bei der Arbeit; dann kann der Schmerz nachlassen. Erwartest du, dass dein Gegenüber alles wiedergutmacht, oder flüchtest dich in Wunschdenken, steckt ihr beide fest.
textsDe.Chiron|Aries 28|H7|Sun Libra 27: In einer engen Beziehung könnte eine alte Kränkung wieder hochkommen: dass ihr einander enttäuscht habt. Es kann helfen, einen Schritt zurückzutreten, bis du beide Seiten siehst, dich dann um das zu kümmern, was wirklich ansteht, und deine Versprechen zu halten; so schließt sich die Wunde vielleicht. Betrachtest du das Problem nur aus sicherer Entfernung, statt es anzupacken, oder gibst deinem Gegenüber die Schuld an deiner Enttäuschung, bleibt die Wunde offen.
textsDe.Chiron|Aries 28|H9: Bei den großen Fragen deines Lebens, etwa wo du leben oder was du lernen willst, könnte ein alter Zweifel fast von selbst nachlassen, wenn du dich für die eine Gelegenheit entscheidest, die am besten zu dir passt, und offen dazu stehst. Manche sind über deine Wahl vielleicht enttäuscht; damit müssen sie selbst zurechtkommen. Zögerst du, weil dich die vielen Möglichkeiten reizen, oder läufst dem Beifall hinterher, bleibt der Zweifel.
textsDe.Chiron|Aries 28|H9|Sun Leo 27: Die alte Enttäuschung darüber, dass du mit deiner Sicht auf das Leben einmal nicht gut angekommen bist, könnte allmählich weniger wehtun, und vielleicht wird dir jeden Tag ein Stück klarer, wofür du stehst. Sag offen, was du denkst, und steh dazu, auch wenn es nicht allen gefällt. Aber nur weil die Enttäuschung gerade fast von selbst nachlässt, solltest du dich nicht zurücklehnen, dir die Dinge schönreden oder einfach der Meinung folgen, die gerade alle haben, statt für deine eigene einzustehen.
textsDe.Jupiter|Leo 26|H1: Das Leben könnte sich wieder hoffnungsvoll anfühlen, und du darfst darauf vertrauen, dass dein beständiger Einsatz ein Grund dafür ist. Bleib auf dem Boden, auch wenn du höher hinauswillst; daraus kann ein Neuanfang wachsen. Werde aber nicht übermütig: Wartest du auf dein Glück oder drückst dich vor den langweiligen Aufgaben des Alltags, kommt der Neuanfang nie in Gang.
textsDe.Jupiter|Leo 26|H10: Ein berufliches Ziel könnte vielversprechend aussehen, doch auf dem Weg dorthin musst du dich wohl immer wieder an veränderte Bedingungen anpassen. Gib nicht auf und nutze, was sich dir an Möglichkeiten bietet; auch in neuen Rollen kannst du dich wohlfühlen. Findest du dich achselzuckend mit weniger ab oder setzt auf einen Glücksfall, kommst du nicht voran.
textsDe.Jupiter|Leo 26|H11: In einem Gruppenprojekt oder im Freundeskreis könnte das, was ihr euch gemeinsam erhofft, jetzt wirklich vorankommen. Bring Wärme, Willenskraft und einen klaren Kopf ein und biete an, einen Teil selbst zu leiten. Schwankst du zwischen großen Plänen und leichtem Vergnügen oder erwartest, dass das Glück die Arbeit macht, verstreicht die Chance.
textsDe.Jupiter|Leo 26|H3: Im Austausch mit Bekannten, in einer Fortbildung oder auf einem kurzen Ausflug könntest du merken, dass sich beständiges Lernen wirklich lohnt. Streich Überflüssiges aus deinem Alltag, dann entdeckst du vielleicht etwas Vertrautes neu und hast Freude daran. Dafür musst du selbst aktiv werden: Bemühst du dich nur halbherzig, nimmst dir zu viel auf einmal vor oder wartest auf Inspiration, bleibt alles fade.
textsDe.Jupiter|Leo 26|H4: Pläne für dein Zuhause oder deine Familie könnten vielversprechend aussehen, doch um sie umzusetzen, brauchst du Geduld und Ehrlichkeit. Sag nur, was du auch meinst, und sei verlässlich da; genau diese Beständigkeit zahlt sich aus. Machst du große Versprechen, redest geschickt um einen Konflikt herum oder hoffst, dass es sich von selbst klärt, bleibt alles, wie es war.
textsDe.Jupiter|Leo 26|H5: In der Freizeit, in der Liebe und bei kreativer Arbeit könnte sich gerade vieles vielversprechend anfühlen, als würde sich beständiger Einsatz endlich lohnen. Such dir die wenigen Freuden aus, die dir wirklich wichtig sind, und widme dich ihnen ganz. Läuft alles so leicht, bist du versucht, dich treiben zu lassen oder nach jedem Angebot zu greifen, und das macht dich bald nervös.
textsDe.Jupiter|Leo 26|H7: In einer engen Beziehung könntest du im einen Moment voller Hoffnung sein und im nächsten überzeugt, dass dein Gegenüber alles aufhält. Schaust du dir an, wie eure Absprachen im Alltag wirklich laufen, und gibst dir weiter Mühe, lohnt sich das meist für beide. Sorgst du dich um jede Kleinigkeit oder wartest darauf, dass dein Gegenüber es richtet, zermürbt dich das.
textsDe.Jupiter|Leo 26|H9: Beim Lernen, auf Reisen oder bei einer Sache, an die du glaubst, könnte gerade vieles wie von selbst laufen und dir zeigen, was sich mit beständigem Einsatz erreichen lässt. Steck deine Kraft in das gemeinsame Ziel und bleib dabei bescheiden. Hältst du hohle Reden oder wartest träge auf den Lohn, bleibt ungenutzt, was möglich wäre.
textsDe.Jupiter|Leo 27|H1: Du fühlst dich womöglich bereit für einen Neuanfang, als läge eine verwirrende Zeit hinter dir und dein Selbstvertrauen wäre zurück. Ergreif eine Chance mutig, mit einem Plan, den du wirklich umsetzen kannst. Gerade dieses Hochgefühl kann dich aber dazu verleiten, dich zu überschätzen, und dann ist das Durcheinander schnell wieder da.
textsDe.Jupiter|Leo 27|H10: Im Beruf und nach außen könnte ein Neuanfang in einer größeren Rolle in Reichweite sein, doch dafür brauchst du mehr Mut, als dir lieb ist. Sag klar, was du willst, und stütze es mit einem Plan. Gibst du dich mit der Routine zufrieden oder prahlst mit Zielen, die du noch nicht durchdacht hast, kommst du nicht weiter.
textsDe.Jupiter|Leo 27|H10|Sun Scorpio 28: In deiner Laufbahn oder einer öffentlichen Rolle kann der Ehrgeiz neu erwachen, mehr zu erreichen, während Erwartungen von außen dir den Kurs vorgeben wollen. Werde dir klar, was du wirklich willst, und konzentrier dich auf dieses eine Ziel. Lässt du dich von Sorgen oder Tagträumen leiten oder verlässt dich aufs Glück, kommst du langsamer voran.
textsDe.Jupiter|Leo 27|H11: In einer Gruppe oder im Freundeskreis könnte ein Vorhaben, das dir am Herzen liegt, neuen Schwung bekommen, und du erkennst womöglich, worauf es im Großen und Ganzen hinausläuft. Sag zu, wenn man dich dazuholt, und übernimm selbst einen praktischen Teil. Schwebst du über den Alltagsfragen oder versprichst zu viel, bleibt alles nur auf dem Papier.
textsDe.Jupiter|Leo 27|H11|Sun Libra 28: Bei einem gemeinsamen Projekt oder unter Menschen, die dir vertraut sind, kann das Gefühl wachsen, dazuzugehören, und mit ihm das Vertrauen, zusammen etwas Neues anzufangen. Bring dich ganz ein, aber prüf vorher die Fakten. Hilfst du nur halbherzig mit oder hoffst, dass es ohne deinen Beitrag klappt, bleibt es bei einer schönen Idee.
textsDe.Jupiter|Leo 27|H1|Sun Leo 28: In dir kann ein Neuanfang Fahrt aufnehmen, mit mehr Selbstvertrauen und mehr Möglichkeiten, als du nutzen kannst. Wähle die, die dich langfristig weiterbringt, und widme ihr deine ganze Aufmerksamkeit. Willst du alles gleichzeitig oder hältst dir zu lange jede Tür offen, verzettelst du dich.
textsDe.Jupiter|Leo 27|H3: Lernen könnte sich wieder frisch anfühlen, etwa in einem Sprachkurs, auf einem kurzen Ausflug oder durch einen neuen Kontakt in deiner Nähe, wenn du dich anmeldest und auch hingehst. Such dir aus, wofür du deine Zeit gern hergibst. Bleibst du am Rand stehen oder greifst nach jeder Idee zugleich, bleibt nichts Neues hängen.
textsDe.Jupiter|Leo 27|H3|Sun Gemini 28: Nach einem Fehlschlag kann der Mut, es noch einmal zu versuchen, langsam zurückkehren, ob in der Nachbarschaft, unter Geschwistern oder in einer Fortbildung. Geh auf andere zu und sieh den Fehler als Übung, nicht als Urteil über dich. Willst du deinen eigenen Anteil daran nicht sehen oder tust so, als wäre nichts gewesen, schiebst du den nächsten Versuch nur hinaus.
textsDe.Jupiter|Leo 27|H4: Zu Hause oder in der Familie reizt es dich womöglich, im großen Stil neu anzufangen, doch der Wunsch allein bringt noch nichts in Bewegung. Plan es in Ruhe, Schritt für Schritt, und bleib beteiligt, ohne alle zu lenken. Mischst du dich in jede Kleinigkeit ein oder zuckst nur mit den Schultern, als wäre alles egal, bleibt zu Hause alles, wie es war.
textsDe.Jupiter|Leo 27|H4|Sun Taurus 28: In deiner Familie oder in deiner Wohnsituation kann der Wunsch nach einem Neubeginn stärker werden, während alte Zweifel, ob du dir so viel zutrauen darfst, immer wieder dagegenhalten. Gib dich nicht aus falscher Bescheidenheit mit weniger zufrieden. Überleg dir, was realistisch ist, und fang dort an. Machst du große Versprechungen oder gibst nach der ersten Enttäuschung auf, bleibt alles beim Alten.
textsDe.Jupiter|Leo 27|H5: Selbst wenn zuletzt etwas danebengegangen ist, kannst du in der Liebe, in deiner Freizeit oder bei einem kreativen Vorhaben jetzt leicht neu anfangen. Am letzten Versuch kannst du ablesen, was Erfolg für dich wirklich bedeutet. Hast du nur große Hoffnungen ohne Plan oder ärgerst dich noch über den Fehlschlag, bleibt die Idee in deinem Kopf stecken.
textsDe.Jupiter|Leo 27|H5|Sun Aries 28: Nach einer verworrenen Zeit kann die Freude am Kennenlernen, an einem Hobby oder an etwas Kreativem zurückkehren, und mit ihr der Mut, zu zeigen, was du gemacht hast. Versprich nur, was du auch halten kannst. Ist jemand anderes enttäuscht, musst du das nicht zu deiner Sache machen. Willst du allen gefallen oder versprichst zu viel, wird aus dem Spaß eine Pflicht.
textsDe.Jupiter|Leo 27|H7: Zwischen dir und einem vertrauten Menschen, privat wie beruflich, will womöglich einer von euch neu anfangen, während der andere festhalten möchte, wie es schon immer war. Frag behutsam, was eure gemeinsamen Gewohnheiten jedem von euch noch bedeuten, etwa ein fester Spieleabend oder ein kleines Ritual im Alltag. Bestehst du stur auf dem Alten oder versprichst das Blaue vom Himmel, belastet das eure Beziehung.
textsDe.Jupiter|Leo 27|H7|Sun Aquarius 28: In einer engen Bindung, privat oder geschäftlich, könnte ein neuer Plan Gestalt annehmen, während einer von euch groß träumt und der andere die Kosten durchrechnet. Plant gemeinsam voraus und teilt euch die praktische Arbeit. Überlässt du die lästigen Aufgaben der anderen Seite oder lässt dich mitreißen, nutzt sich eure Beziehung ab.
textsDe.Jupiter|Leo 27|H9: Egal ob du etwas Neues lernst, verreist oder dein Wissen weitergibst: Es kann sich wieder leicht und frisch anfühlen. Gib deiner Vorstellung davon, wie es sein sollte, eine sichtbare Form, etwa als Text, als Projekt oder als Vortrag. Bleibt es bei einem schönen Tagtraum oder wird daraus eine Belehrung, ist es verflogen, sobald die gute Laune nachlässt.
textsDe.Jupiter|Leo 27|H9|Sun Sagittarius 28: Wenn du lernst, reist oder anderen etwas beibringst, eröffnet sich dir womöglich ganz leicht ein neuer Blick auf das Leben, und du siehst, wie du ihn in deinen Alltag holen kannst. Bau etwas, das gut funktioniert und das man gern benutzt, etwa einen Ablauf oder ein Angebot. Bleibst du aus Bequemlichkeit beim Gewohnten oder predigst nur darüber, bleibt dein neuer Gedanke ungenutzt.
textsDe.Mars|Leo 26|H1: Du traust dir gerade viel zu und willst etwas neu anfangen, etwa einen Sport, eine Ausbildung oder ein eigenes Projekt, und bleibst dabei auch dran. Arbeite weiter daran und rechne damit, dass Freude folgt. Wartest du darauf, dass dir alles in den Schoß fällt, oder lässt langweilige Aufgaben liegen, verliert dein Neuanfang an Schwung.
textsDe.Mars|Leo 26|H10: Deine Ambitionen bekommen echten Rückenwind, doch der Erfolg kommt aus beständiger, entschlossener Arbeit, nicht aus einem Glücksspiel. Bleib auf dem Boden und arbeite weiter. Langweilst du dich und läufst davon oder erzwingst Ergebnisse durch Konfrontation, verspielst du den Erfolg.
textsDe.Mars|Leo 26|H11: Beharrliche Arbeit im Freundeskreis oder in einer Gemeinschaft zeigt endlich Ergebnisse, und es öffnet sich die Möglichkeit, weiterzugehen. Nutze sie mit Zuversicht. Verlierst du das Interesse, sobald es Routine wird, oder verlässt dich aufs Glück, versandet es.
textsDe.Mars|Leo 26|H3: Wenn du eine Fähigkeit übst oder ein Gespräch am Laufen hältst, zeigen sich Ergebnisse, und die Chance weiterzugehen tut sich auf. Nutze sie mit geduldiger Energie. Jagst du aus Langeweile einem schnellen Nervenkitzel nach oder überlässt es dem Glück, endet es zu früh.
textsDe.Mars|Leo 26|H4: Du willst zu Hause etwas verbessern, aber die anderen ziehen nicht gleich mit. Mach trotzdem weiter, denn hier bringt beständige Arbeit Ergebnisse. Erledige weiter auch die langweiligen, notwendigen Teile. Verlierst du die Geduld und stürmst davon oder flüchtest in etwas Aufregenderes, bleibt alles halb fertig.
textsDe.Mars|Leo 26|H5: Du hast gerade große Lust, etwas zu erschaffen oder dich ganz auf die Liebe einzulassen, und es geht dir leicht von der Hand. Bleib beständig dabei und vertrau darauf, dass es sich lohnt. Wartest du träge auf einen Glücksfall oder lässt es fallen, sobald es langweilig wird, verpufft der Funke.
textsDe.Mars|Leo 26|H7: Du drängst einen Menschen, mit dem du eng zusammenarbeitest, auf Ergebnisse und erwartest, dass die Zusagen eingehalten werden. Bring deinen eigenen geduldigen Einsatz ein; gemeinsame Arbeit trägt Früchte, wenn die Bedingungen stimmen. Suchst du aus Langeweile Streit oder gibst dem anderen die Schuld, nutzt sich die Zusammenarbeit ab.
textsDe.Mars|Leo 26|H9: Dein Vertrauen, dass sich Ausdauer lohnt, lässt sich beim Lernen, auf Reisen oder bei einem größeren Lebensplan leicht in Taten umsetzen. Verfolge das langfristige Ziel und lass dich von Freude antreiben. Verlässt du dich nur auf Hoffnung oder flüchtest vor allem Langweiligen, erreichst du das Ziel nicht.
textsDe.Mars|Leo 27|H1: Nach einer verwirrenden Phase kannst du dich wie ein neuer Mensch fühlen, mit Lust, etwas anzufangen und anders aufzutreten. Derselbe Schwung, der dich antreibt, kann dich aber auch unbedacht oder dünnhäutig machen. Gib deshalb jedem Neuanfang einen konkreten ersten Schritt.
textsDe.Mars|Leo 27|H10: Im Beruf kannst du endlich wieder klarsehen und hast Lust, einen neuen Weg auszuprobieren, doch die, die das Sagen haben, könnten sich querstellen. Untermauere deine Idee mit einem realistischen Plan und bleib dran. Verlierst du die Beherrschung oder gibst auf, bist du am Ende weiter vom Ziel entfernt als vorher.
textsDe.Mars|Leo 27|H11: In deinem Freundeskreis oder einer Gruppe, zu der du gehörst, könnte ein ins Stocken geratener Plan wieder Fahrt aufnehmen. Schlag einen realistischen nächsten Schritt vor. Denn wenn du wartest, bis die anderen sich bewegen, oder zu sehr drängst, bleibt das Vorhaben womöglich wieder stecken.
textsDe.Mars|Leo 27|H3: Nach einem Missverständnis mit Geschwistern oder in der Nachbarschaft könntest du die Gelegenheit bekommen, die Sache zu klären und neu anzufangen. Geh den ersten Schritt und sag klar, wie du dazu stehst. Wartest du nur ab oder rutscht dir ein scharfes Wort heraus, bleibt womöglich alles ungeklärt.
textsDe.Mars|Leo 27|H4: Nach einer verworrenen Zeit möchtest du in der Familie und in deinem Zuhause neu anfangen, doch die anderen würden womöglich lieber alles lassen, wie es ist. Mach aus deinem Wunsch nach Veränderung einen Plan, der im Alltag funktioniert. Denn wenn du die anderen anfährst oder gleich aufgibst, bleibt die Spannung zwischen euch bestehen.
textsDe.Mars|Leo 27|H5: Nach einer lustlosen Zeit kann deine Begeisterung für Flirts, Spaß oder ein eigenes kreatives Vorhaben mit neuer Kraft zurückkehren. Ein Neuanfang gelingt dir gerade leicht. Gib der neuen Idee einen einfachen Plan und geh einen ersten Schritt, bevor die Ungeduld sie wieder beiseiteschiebt.
textsDe.Mars|Leo 27|H7: Ein Missverständnis mit jemandem, der dir wichtig ist, ob privat oder im Beruf, möchtest du womöglich hinter dir lassen, während dein Gegenüber noch daran festhält, oder umgekehrt. Sag, was du als Nächstes gemeinsam versuchen willst. Schiebt ihr euch gegenseitig die Schuld zu, geht der Streit von vorn los.
textsDe.Mars|Leo 27|H9: Nach einer Zeit voller Zweifel kann deine Lust zurückkehren, zu verreisen, etwas Neues zu lernen oder einen mutigen Plan anzugehen. Du kannst jetzt ohne große Mühe handeln: Buch die Reise oder melde dich für die Fortbildung oder den Sprachkurs an. Stürz dich nur nicht unvorbereitet hinein, und lass es auch nicht beim Tagtraum bleiben.
textsDe.Mars|Leo 28|H1: Du hast gerade womöglich die Kraft, eine Menge anzupacken, und ein Teil von dir genießt es, dir alle Möglichkeiten offenzuhalten. Entscheide, welches Ziel wirklich deins ist, und bleib dabei. Wer alles auf einmal will, ist am Ende meist frustriert.
textsDe.Mars|Leo 28|H10: Beruflich buhlen womöglich mehrere Projekte oder Schritte um deine Kraft, und keine dieser Möglichkeiten ist ohne Haken. Entscheide dich für die, die dich langfristig weiterbringt, und geh ihre Schwachstelle direkt an. Wer alles gleichzeitig jonglieren will, ist bald überfordert und gereizt.
textsDe.Mars|Leo 28|H11: Aus dem Freundeskreis oder von Bekannten könnten mehr Angebote und Pläne kommen, als du überhaupt mitmachen kannst. Such dir das aus, was zu deinen Wünschen für die nächsten Jahre passt, und sag klar Ja dazu. Springst du zwischen allem hin und her, erschöpft dich das, und du bist bald kurz angebunden.
textsDe.Mars|Leo 28|H3: Gerade häufen sich womöglich Nachrichten, Einladungen und kleine Angebote, und eines davon könnte sich wirklich lohnen, etwa ein Seminar oder ein nützlicher Kontakt. Such es dir heraus und melde dich selbst. Beantwortest du alles nur halbherzig, bist du zwar beschäftigt, aber gereizt und kommst nicht vom Fleck.
textsDe.Mars|Leo 28|H4: Zu Hause könnte gerade vieles gleichzeitig deine Kraft beanspruchen, von Plänen in der Familie über Reparaturen bis zu einem möglichen Umzug. Nimm dir das Dringendste vor und pack es direkt an. Willst du alles auf einmal erledigen oder schaust lieber weg, bist du bald angespannt und schnell gereizt.
textsDe.Mars|Leo 28|H5: Gerade bieten sich dir womöglich viele Gelegenheiten zum Flirten, Feiern oder Ausprobieren, und du hast genug Schwung, sie zu ergreifen. Du spürst schnell, was dir am meisten Freude macht, und kannst dich leicht dafür entscheiden. Willst du allem gleichzeitig nachjagen, wird nichts fertig, und deine Laune leidet.
textsDe.Mars|Leo 28|H7: Zwischen dir und deinem Gegenüber, in der Liebe wie im Beruf, möchte womöglich eine Seite eine Gelegenheit sofort nutzen, während die andere noch abwägt. Einigt euch auf einen gemeinsamen Schritt und sprecht offen aus, wo es hakt. Zieht ihr in entgegengesetzte Richtungen, endet es im Streit.
